items.text: Kittle will feast on WR outs (scheme + injuries, ignore TE Day narrative); tempted by CMC more slot vs WR injuries + Black; Burden 2.56 YPRR on 68.8% routes, Kmet IR juices; Henderson only 21% snaps last 3wks; Jacobs facility access but Lloyd/Johnson backups poor EPA.

items.opportunity: Kittle funnel routes/targets; Burden route % up; CMC receiving; Jacobs lead if clear

items.text: Cole Kmet to IR season-ending knee (carted, serious); Ben Johnson confirm. Boosts Burden routes (already elite YPRR).
items.implication: Burden WR2/3 upside, less 2/3 TE sets

items.text: Love AJ Brown (33% ts/97% routes despite drops), DeVonta Smith, Matthew Golden (deep targets vs DET 3rd-worst deep comp%), Tucker Kraft vs DET; Hate Rome Odunze, Josh Downs (ts issues), Travis Kelce (tough matchup).
items.opportunity: High routes/ts for loves; volume for Kraft/Golden

items.text: Hate Josh Jacobs (workload questions post-layoff vs DET), plus Skattebo/Wilson; Love Warren/Hubbard/Irving for workloads + soft matchups.
items.why: Layoff rust risk, matchup, consistent workloads elsewhere
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility but poor backups
